decisions: A top-level attribute produced for an existing typed/raw template sequence is a parentless sequence item. Use its placeholder accumulator to preserve position and duplicate attribute items. Attributes constructed inside ordinary element content retain existing complex-content ordering errors.

The existing standalone attribute evaluator owns its temporary materialization container; the typed-template route must not intercept that nested evaluator's returned attribute, including during simple content construction for xsl:namespace.
Identify the current typed template's own root container explicitly; inherited collector flags alone must not classify nested simple-content temporary containers as that root.

Canonicalize only secondary capture-map lookup keys using the same existing host resolver as assert-result-document. Preserve processor current-output-uri behavior and the captured node's existing URI annotations. This repairs host lookup consistency for relative keys without claiming broader no-base-output-URI semantics.

Replace the rounded percentage with an explicit selected-case PASS/FAIL/NO EXECUTED CASES line; counts and exclusions remain authoritative. Retain legacy exit behavior and independent qualification-controller refusal of failed or incomplete runs.
scope: No expected fixture edits, skip admissions, schema expansion, percentage conformance claim or automatic standalone-gate promotion. Preserve all historical cohorts and original diagnostics.
